Set a minimum dwell time

Source: R/set_min_dwell_time.R
set_min_dwell_time.Rd

Raises the dwell time of each specified trip_id at each specified stop_id to at least min_dwell_time, i.e. makes vehicles stay at least that long at the stops, by delaying the departure_time at these stops in stop_times and shifting the later times of the trips accordingly.

Usage

set_min_dwell_time(
  gtfs,
  min_dwell_time,
  unit = "s",
  trip_id = NULL,
  stop_id = NULL,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  route_type = NULL,
  by_reference = FALSE
)

Arguments

gtfs

A GTFS object, as created by read_gtfs().

min_dwell_time

A non-negative number, the minimum dwell time, in unit. It's rounded to the nearest whole second.

unit

A string representing the time unit in which min_dwell_time is given. One of "s" (seconds, the default), "min" (minutes), "h" (hours) or "d" (days).

trip_id

A character vector including the trip_ids to have their dwell times raised. If NULL (the default), the dwell times of every trip_id in the GTFS (or of every trip of the given route_types) are raised.

stop_id

A character vector including the stop_ids at which the dwell times are raised. If NULL (the default), the dwell times are raised at every stop_id in the GTFS.

from

A string, in the "HH:MM:SS" format. Only visits whose arrival time is at or after from are changed. If NULL (the default), there is no lower limit.

to

A string, in the "HH:MM:SS" format. Only visits whose arrival time is at or before to are changed. If NULL (the default), there is no upper limit.

route_type

An integer vector of route_types (see filter_by_route_type()). If given, only trips of routes of these types are changed; together with the other selection arguments, it restricts their selection. route_types not listed in routes are ignored. If NULL (the default), trips of any type are changed.

by_reference

Whether to update stop_times' data.table by reference. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

If by_reference is set to FALSE, returns a GTFS object with the time columns of its stop_times adjusted. Else, returns a GTFS object invisibly (note that in this case the original GTFS object is altered).

Details

The function selects the visits of every specified trip to every specified stop, within the time of day if from or to is given, as set_dwell_time() does. At each selected visit whose dwell time is shorter than min_dwell_time, the arrival time is kept and the departure time is set to the arrival time plus min_dwell_time. The later times of the trip are shifted accordingly, so the trip ends later. Longer dwell times are kept, so no dwell time is ever shortened.

The first and last visits of each trip with both an arrival and a departure time are never changed, so trips keep their start times. These are found among all the visits of the trip, not only the selected ones. Visits whose departure is earlier than their arrival (negative dwell times, e.g. times after midnight written as "00:30:00") are not changed either. Use set_dwell_time() to change these visits.

Otherwise it works as set_dwell_time().

See also

set_dwell_time(), get_dwell_time(), fix_gtfs()

Examples

data_path <- system.file("extdata/spo_gtfs.zip", package = "gtfstools")
gtfs <- read_gtfs(data_path)

# vehicles stay 0 seconds at the stops of this trip. make them stay at least
# 30 seconds at each intermediate stop
head(get_dwell_time(gtfs, trip_id = "CPTM L07-0"))
#>       trip_id stop_id stop_sequence dwell_time
#>        <char>  <char>         <int>      <num>
#> 1: CPTM L07-0   18940             1          0
#> 2: CPTM L07-0   18920             2          0
#> 3: CPTM L07-0   18919             3          0
#> 4: CPTM L07-0   18917             4          0
#> 5: CPTM L07-0   18916             5          0
#> 6: CPTM L07-0   18965             6          0

new_gtfs <- set_min_dwell_time(gtfs, 30, trip_id = "CPTM L07-0")
head(get_dwell_time(new_gtfs, trip_id = "CPTM L07-0"))
#>       trip_id stop_id stop_sequence dwell_time
#>        <char>  <char>         <int>      <num>
#> 1: CPTM L07-0   18940             1          0
#> 2: CPTM L07-0   18920             2         30
#> 3: CPTM L07-0   18919             3         30
#> 4: CPTM L07-0   18917             4         30
#> 5: CPTM L07-0   18916             5         30
#> 6: CPTM L07-0   18965             6         30
